sources.population: World Bank WDI SP.POP.TOTL (total, mid-year estimate), accessed Oct 2026
sources.fx_rate: World Bank WDI PA.NUS.FCRF (official rate, LCU per USD, annual average), accessed Oct 2026; USA fixed at 1.0

fx_definition: Annual average units of local currency per 1 US dollar (calendar-year basis, Dec 31 year-end convention)
news_note: 2-3 major geopolitical events per year, editorial selection with one-line summaries

geopolitical_news.headline: Democrats retake Congress
geopolitical_news.summary: November midterms punish Bush over Iraq; defence secretary Rumsfeld resigns.

geopolitical_news.headline: Iraq violence peaks
geopolitical_news.summary: Sectarian bloodshed escalates; US casualties mount through the year.

geopolitical_news.headline: Iraq troop surge
geopolitical_news.summary: Bush orders 20,000 more troops; violence gradually falls by year-end.

geopolitical_news.headline: Subprime crisis begins
geopolitical_news.summary: Housing defaults spread; Bear Stearns hedge funds collapse in the summer.

geopolitical_news.headline: Financial crisis erupts
geopolitical_news.summary: Lehman Brothers collapses in September; global markets convulse.

geopolitical_news.headline: Obama elected president
geopolitical_news.summary: November victory makes Barack Obama the first Black US president.

geopolitical_news.headline: Stimulus and healthcare push
geopolitical_news.summary: The $787bn ARRA passes in February; the health reform battle dominates the year.

geopolitical_news.headline: Afghanistan surge ordered
geopolitical_news.summary: Obama sends 30,000 more troops to Afghanistan in December.

geopolitical_news.headline: Affordable Care Act signed
geopolitical_news.summary: Landmark health law passes in March on party-line votes.

geopolitical_news.headline: Tea Party wave in midterms
geopolitical_news.summary: Republicans retake the House in November amid backlash to Obama.

geopolitical_news.headline: Bin Laden killed
geopolitical_news.summary: May raid in Abbottabad, Pakistan ends the 9/11 mastermind's decade on the run.

geopolitical_news.headline: Debt-ceiling crisis
geopolitical_news.summary: August standoff brings the US near default; S&P downgrades US debt.

geopolitical_news.headline: Obama re-elected
geopolitical_news.summary: November win over Romney; Democrats keep the Senate.

geopolitical_news.headline: Benghazi attack
geopolitical_news.summary: September assault on the US consulate in Libya kills four Americans.

geopolitical_news.headline: Government shutdown
geopolitical_news.summary: A 16-day October shutdown follows a failed GOP bid to defund Obamacare.

geopolitical_news.headline: Snowden leaks
geopolitical_news.summary: June revelations expose NSA mass surveillance; Snowden flees to Russia.

geopolitical_news.headline: Sanctions over Crimea
geopolitical_news.summary: US leads Western sanctions after Russia annexes Crimea in March.

geopolitical_news.headline: Airstrikes against ISIS begin
geopolitical_news.summary: US bombs ISIS targets in Iraq and Syria as the group seizes Mosul.

geopolitical_news.headline: Iran nuclear deal signed
geopolitical_news.summary: July JCPOA trades sanctions relief for curbs on Iran's nuclear program.

geopolitical_news.headline: Paris climate accord
geopolitical_news.summary: December deal commits the US to emissions cuts.

geopolitical_news.headline: Trump elected president
geopolitical_news.summary: November upset over Clinton upends US politics and alliances.

geopolitical_news.headline: Russia interference alleged
geopolitical_news.summary: US intelligence blames Moscow for hacks aimed at the campaign.

geopolitical_news.headline: Travel ban turmoil
geopolitical_news.summary: January executive order restricting entry from Muslim-majority nations sparks protests and court fights.

geopolitical_news.headline: Charlottesville violence
geopolitical_news.summary: August white-supremacist rally turns deadly; Trump's response draws bipartisan fire.

geopolitical_news.headline: Trade war with China begins
geopolitical_news.summary: July tariffs on $34bn of Chinese goods open a multi-year trade conflict.

geopolitical_news.headline: Democrats retake the House
geopolitical_news.summary: November midterms deliver a check on Trump's power.

geopolitical_news.headline: Trump impeached
geopolitical_news.summary: December impeachment over Ukraine pressure; acquitted by the Senate in 2020.

geopolitical_news.headline: Phase-one China deal
geopolitical_news.summary: December truce pauses tariff escalation.

geopolitical_news.headline: COVID-19 pandemic
geopolitical_news.summary: Lockdowns and 350,000+ US deaths; the economy crashes then partially recovers.

geopolitical_news.headline: Biden defeats Trump
geopolitical_news.summary: November election victory; Trump refuses to concede.

geopolitical_news.headline: Capitol riot
geopolitical_news.summary: January 6 mob storms Congress as it certifies Biden's win.

geopolitical_news.headline: Afghanistan withdrawal
geopolitical_news.summary: Chaotic August exit ends 20 years of war; the Taliban retakes Kabul.

geopolitical_news.headline: US rallies support for Ukraine
geopolitical_news.summary: February Russian invasion triggers massive US military aid and sanctions.

geopolitical_news.headline: Dobbs ends federal abortion rights
geopolitical_news.summary: June Supreme Court ruling overturns Roe v. Wade.

geopolitical_news.headline: Debt-ceiling standoff resolved
geopolitical_news.summary: McCarthy-Biden deal in June averts a US default.

geopolitical_news.headline: US backs Israel after October 7
geopolitical_news.summary: Hamas attack triggers US military aid to Israel and the Gaza war.

geopolitical_news.headline: Trump re-elected
geopolitical_news.summary: November comeback makes Trump the second president to win non-consecutive terms.

geopolitical_news.headline: Biden drops out
geopolitical_news.summary: July withdrawal after a disastrous debate; Harris becomes the nominee.

geopolitical_news.headline: Trump's second term begins
geopolitical_news.summary: January inauguration launches mass deportations and a federal overhaul.

geopolitical_news.headline: Liberation Day tariffs
geopolitical_news.summary: Sweeping April tariffs ignite a global trade war.
